question: Can one source-independent, bounded low-frequency scale field explain P4CJ's transferable high-order archival residual structure while retaining the fixed P4BS Thomas second-order spectrum?

primary_sources.title: AbsoluteDegradation: A Physics-Inspired Synthetic Film-Degradation Pipeline and Archival Film Restoration Benchmark
primary_sources.use: latest 2026 public archival benchmark and signal-dependent/nonstationary motivation; its exact released blue-noise executable is closed by P4CK

primary_sources.title: Realistic Film Noise Generation Based on Experimental Noise Spectra
primary_sources.use: measured-film precedent for spatially varying local noise statistics with preserved cross-region correlation; no code or data is copied

dataset.selection_rule: After excluding all four P4CJ sources, sort eligible source names whose first clip has exactly ten PNG frames; take the next eight sources. First four are development and last four are confirmation.
dataset.download_destination_rule: caller-owned scratch outside the unavailable repository data junction

patch_observation.scalar_decode: uint8 PNG BT.709 code-luma divided by 255
patch_observation.selection: lowest low-pass gradient RMS with y/x tie break
patch_observation.residual_normalization: subtract mean and divide by population RMS

candidate.name: bounded_compound_thomas_v1
candidate.base: zero-DC Gaussian random field with exact fixed P4BS Thomas power
candidate.scale_field: independent zero-mean unit-RMS Gaussian field with 12-pixel Gaussian low-pass amplitude, transformed by exp(s*z-0.5*s^2), clipped to [0.25,4.0]
candidate.fit_parameter: single global log-scale standard deviation s
candidate.fit_rule: 32-step bisection on [0,1.5] matching the median development local_energy_cv_8x8 to the median of 256 fixed-seed candidate fields; fail if the target is outside endpoint predictions
candidate.feature_distance: RMS difference between observed and model feature medians after scaling all differences by the fixed Gaussian-control feature MAD floor 1e-6

branch_rule.pass: Retain one generic nonstationary compound-Thomas research mechanism and open disjoint photographic severe-artifact composition only.
branch_rule.fail: Close the exact one-parameter scale-mixture mechanism without changing envelope scale, bounds, fit rule, features, sources or gates.

forbidden: read confirmation pixels before the single parameter and all model-control statistics are frozen
fit per-source parameters or use source identity at application
change sources, patches, scale, bounds, feature set, sample counts or gates after download
claim emulsion, stock, scanner or microscopic calibration from archival display-code residuals
integrate the P4BZ-closed photographic hybrid regardless of this result
claim_ceiling: Generic archival-code nonstationary residual mechanism evidence only; scanner/restoration/content remain mixed and no stock, physical calibration, visual safety or product claim is allowed.
